raw.details:
Hexwartz: Where Code Meets Magic

Choose your House. Build your spell.

HexWartz is a Harry Potter-themed hackathon hosted at Sharda University Agra, on 13-14 November 2026. Teams are sorted into four Houses, each representing a problem statement, and compete to turn their ideas into working solutions.

Event Highlights

  • Dates: 13-14 November 2026
  • Venue: Sharda University Agra (final round offline)
  • Team size: 4-6 members (individual participation is not allowed)
  • Prize pool: ₹50,000 and more
  • Perks: Certificates, Exciting goodies, accommodation, food

The Four Houses (problem Statements)

House Track
Gryffindor                   AI/ML
Ravenclaw                Healthcare
Hufflepuff            SDG (Sustainable Development Goals)
Slytherin        Open Innovation (Any domain)

Each team chooses one House and builds a solution for that track.

Eligibility

  • Open to all undergraduate and postgraduate students from any recognized college or university.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Every participant must carry a valid college ID.

Rounds

Round 1: Shortlisting PPT Round (Online)

  • Submit a PPT covering the problem, your solution, tech stack and expected impact. The best teams from each House are shortlisted for the final round.

Round 2: Final Offline Round

  • Shortlisted teams build a working prototype at Sharda University Agra, with mentor support. Teams then demo and pitch to a panel of judges, followed by a live Q&A.

Judging Criteria:

  • Innovation and originality
  • Technical implementation and feasibility
  • Real-world impact and scalability
  • Quality of the final pitch and demo

Prizes and Perks:

  • Prize pool of ₹50,000+
  • Certificates for all participants
  • Goodies for all participants
  • Accommodation for participants of the final offline round
  • Food for participants of the final offline round
  • Incubation support for promising startups from Sharda University Agra

Registration Fee:

  • Round 1 is free.
  • A fee of ₹250 per team member is payable only after your team is shortlisted.

Ready to choose your House? Register on Unstop and let the magic begin.
